generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The tenderer should be a PWD registered and above Contractor

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should furnish qualification information as per clause-3 and section- 3 of Standard Tender Document attached to this tender and all the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled by the tenderer in full and complete manner.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and legible. At the time of opening of technical bid all the original documents should be produced for verification without fail to the Executive Engineer, Superintending Engineer, Chief Engineer. Otherwise the tender will be rejected. During the time of evaluation of bids, if the employer finds any certification / information furnished is false, such tender will be rejected.
Work done certificate should be issued by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer with work indent number is compulsory.
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit(FDR) for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price.
Additional security for unbalanced tenders amount put to tender and quoted amount should be in FDR for 365 day in favour of EE,PRED,Chitradurga. Contractor should be produced before the work order.
The defect liability period is 1 year from the date of complication of work failing which action will be taken as per tender condition.
The cost of tender fee shall not be refundable. No interest will be paid by the Government on the Earnest money deposit.

The rates quoted shall be through rates for finished items of work inclusive of all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, all incidental charges and all taxes Local or General, Royalty etc., complete payable to the Government or Local bodies in the Region.
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment. The Contractor should maintain the work during defective liability period as per contract conditions.

Omission and Typographical errors which is in the opinion of the Executive Engineer, will not be a ground for claims of extra payment. If any of the dates mentioned happens to be a general holiday, the next working day will holds good.
Liquid assets and/or availabity of Credit facilities of not less than 30% of amount put to tender (credit lines/ letter credit/ certificates from banks without condition.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, P.R.E.Division, Chitradurga during office hours on all working days.
All tenders are accepted or rejected by the Executive Engineer,PRED.Division, Chitradurga is reserved.
Profit and loss acccounts and turnovers must be signed by CA with UDIN number.
Condition mentioned in Bid document KW-4 is accepted.
Item rates are excluding GST. GST amount will be paid seperately as per prevailling rules.
